description: This file contains functions and types for configuring secrets in an OpenClaw project, including interactive prompts for secret providers, agent profiles, and secret references, as well as plan creation and validation logic.

methods.name: isAbsolutePathValue
methods.description: Checks if a string is an absolute path, considering Windows-specific path patterns.

methods.name: parseCsv
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into an array of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: parseOptionalPositiveInt
methods.description: Parses a string into a positive integer within a maximum bound, or returns undefined.

methods.name: getSecretProviders
methods.description: Retrieves secret providers configuration from the main config object.

methods.name: setSecretProvider
methods.description: Sets or updates a secret provider configuration in the main config object.

methods.name: removeSecretProvider
methods.description: Removes a secret provider by alias from the configuration, cleaning up defaults if necessary.

methods.name: providerHint
methods.description: Generates a descriptive hint string for a secret provider based on its source and mode.

methods.name: toSourceChoices
methods.description: Creates a list of available secret source options based on current providers.

methods.name: assertNoCancel
methods.description: Throws an error if the value is a symbol, used to handle cancellation in prompts.

methods.name: validateEnvNameCsv
methods.description: Validates a CSV string of environment variable names against a pattern.

methods.name: promptEnvNameCsv
methods.description: Prompts the user to input a CSV of environment variable names with validation.

methods.name: promptOptionalPositiveInt
methods.description: Prompts the user for an optional positive integer within a max bound.

methods.name: configureCandidateKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for a secret configuration candidate.

methods.name: hasSourceChoice
methods.description: Checks if a source choice exists within a list of source options.

methods.name: resolveCandidateProviderHint
methods.description: Resolves a hint string for a candidate's provider or auth profile.

methods.name: resolveSuggestedEnvSecretId
methods.description: Suggests an environment variable name for a secret candidate based on hints.

methods.name: resolveConfigureAgentId
methods.description: Resolves or validates an agent ID, defaulting if not provided.

methods.name: normalizeAuthStoreForConfigure
methods.description: Normalizes raw auth store data into a structured AuthProfileStore object.

methods.name: loadAuthProfileStoreForConfigure
methods.description: Loads and normalizes the auth profile store for a given agent ID.

methods.name: promptNewAuthProfileCandidate
methods.description: Interactively prompts the user to create a new auth profile candidate.

methods.name: promptProviderAlias
methods.description: Prompts the user to input a secret provider alias with validation.

methods.name: promptProviderSource
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a secret provider source type.

methods.name: promptEnvProvider
methods.description: Interactively prompts for environment variable allowlist configuration.

methods.name: promptFileProvider
methods.description: Interactively prompts for file provider configuration.

methods.name: parseArgsInput
methods.description: Parses a raw JSON string into an array of argument strings.

methods.name: promptExecProvider
methods.description: Interactively prompts for an exec command provider configuration.

methods.name: promptProviderConfig
methods.description: Prompts the user to configure a secret provider based on source type.

methods.name: configureProvidersInteractive
methods.description: Interactive loop to add, edit, or remove secret providers.

methods.name: runSecretsConfigureInteractive
methods.description: Main exported function to run the interactive secrets configuration process.
